title: Bumble ditches its rule that kept men from making the first move
summary: Bumble is officially giving up on the rule that made it, well, Bumble. According to Bumble’s survey data, 66% of women surveyed said they prefer men to send the first message, with many saying it would make dating feel less stressful.
